title: ZIP centroids (zip_centroids.yaml)
description: Optional. Approximate centre of each ZIP, for 'services near this ZIP' radius search (catalog.get_all_services, the search_services tool). A ZIP not listed, or a pack without this file, is not radius-filtered. featured ZIPs are the scripted intake's quick replies. Read by catalog_loader.load_zip_centroids into ZipCentroid.

featured.description: Offer as a quick reply in the scripted intake (file order). With none featured, the first five are used.
